body.x: Moodo introduced smart home perfume machine with a wide range of odors at 'CES 2018 Unveiled' in 7th of January in Las Vegas, United States.

Designed to improve the quality of the life, smart home perfume machines can create their own unique moods immediately depending on their customers’ tastes. There are total of 20 kinds of smell and set products with four concepts including Ashram Spa that offers the best choice of adventure or meditation with the aroma of raw essential oil, fresh taste of natural beach party, the feeling of a warm home, and the feeling of a good sense of smell when you are refreshing, so that users can have a wide choice.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
